newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss unemployment seen rising in '97 - trade office.
newsitem.headline: Swiss unemployment seen rising in '97 - trade office.

text.p: The average unemployment rate in Switzerland is likely to rise in 1997 after reaching 4.7 percent in 1996, the Swiss Office of Trade, Industry and Labour said.
The office earlier this morning also reported a December jobless rate of 5.3 percent after 5.1 percent in November.

"Even if a stabilising of the unemployment numbers, or even a slight decline comes in spring and in summer, the average joblessness level will be between 15,000 and 20,000 higher than last year before we can anticipate a slight decline in 1998," the office said in documents released in Berne. -- Zurich Editorial +41 631 7340
